principle: NN/g #3 User control and freedom; WCAG 2.2 §2.4.11 (analogous, element obscured); NN/g #1 Visibility of system status
problem: VERIFY UX-1301 = FAIL. The gap-fill dialog is still NOT a true viewport-bottom sheet on mobile — the desktop cell-anchored inline top wins. Tapping an upper coverage cell (cell top=68px) at 375 produced dialog top=-359px (computed top -359.6px, identical to v13), close button at y=-351 (44×44 but onScreen=false), header off-screen, almost the entire 380px dialog above y=0. At 414: dialog top=-306, close at y=-298, off-screen. The user sees nothing render and cannot dismiss except Escape (phones lack it). This is the #1 launch-gating mobile bug and it is unfixed in prod.
fix: (Source fix likely already in commit b401e06.) On coarse-pointer/<768px render the gap-fill dialog as a true viewport-bottom sheet decoupled from the cell anchor: top:auto !important (drop the cell-anchored inline top on mobile), bottom: calc(60px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)), left/right:8px, max-height:70vh, dialog BODY scrolls internally so header + × + WANT actions stay on-screen. Verify after deploy: tap a cell at viewport-top, assert close button top>=0.

principle: React SSR/CSR hydration correctness; Laws of UX — Doherty Threshold
location: GLOBAL — live 'HH:MM:SS' status-bar clock (renders at ALL widths incl. 375, not just >=768)
problem: VERIFY UX-1309 = FAIL (partial). React minified error #418 (hydration mismatch) STILL fires on the genuine cold first load of a fresh browser context at 375 (captured this session). It no longer fires on warm reloads/cache-busted navs (improved), but the cold-load mismatch persists. The v13 hypothesis that the clock is >=768-only is WRONG: the live 'HH:MM:SS' clock (e.g. 13:52:34) renders at 375/414/768 and shows the REAL hydrated time, not the '--:--:--' SSR placeholder the v13 note claimed — so either the suppressHydrationWarning/useEffect gating (commit 9c9fffb) is not in the live build (consistent with UX-1400) or the placeholder gating isn't actually preventing the mismatch. A first-time recruit hits the cold path.
fix: (Source fix in commit 9c9fffb may resolve once deployed — re-verify cold-load console first.) If #418 persists after deploy: render the clock client-only (useEffect-set, empty string on server) AND keep suppressHydrationWarning on the time node; or wrap the whole status bar in a client-only mount guard. Verify by opening a brand-new browser context (cold chunks) at 375 and asserting console has 0 React #418.

principle: NN/g #1 Visibility of system status; NN/g #2 Match between system and real world; NN/g #9 Help users recover
location: /wishlist → URL-paste add flow (NEW issue this round)
problem: NEW. Pasting a clear MODEL/kit vendor URL (https://www.games-workshop.com/en-GB/space-marine-intercessors) into the wishlist add box produced a row that (a) was classified as a PAINT, not a MODEL — it landed under 'PAINTS · 2' while 'MODELS · 0' stayed empty — and (b) was NOT auto-filled: the title became the bare domain 'games-workshop.com' with the raw URL as the body, no product name, no price. The on-page promise ('Paste a vendor URL to auto-fill the row… Each row gets sorted into Models or Paints automatically') is not met — likely because there is no live scrape/enrichment backend yet, so it falls back to domain-as-title and a Paint default. The system's stated behaviour diverges from reality, and a model is silently misfiled into Paints with no signal to the user.
fix: Either (1) wire the URL enrichment so a vendor URL resolves to a real title + category + price, or (2) be honest about the offline limitation: when only a URL is available, title the row from the URL slug ('space-marine-intercessors') not the bare domain, default obvious kit/box URLs to MODELS (or prompt the user to pick Model/Paint), and soften the copy to 'Paste a vendor URL to save the link — auto-fill arrives with the live integration'. Add a category selector on the new row so the user can correct the auto-sort. needs_human to choose path (1) vs (2).
